name: @activepieces/piece-vero
description: Vero is an event-based messaging platform. Increase conversions and customer satisfaction by sending more targeted emails.

aliasAUser.name: aliasAUser
aliasAUser.description: Change a user's identifier by merging two user identities into one

id.description: The old unique identifier of the user

new_id.description: The new unique identifier of the user

aiMetadata.description: Re-identifies a Vero user by remapping an existing record from an old user ID to a new user ID, merging the two identities. Use when a user's stable identifier has changed and their history must be preserved under the new ID. Both the old and new IDs are required; re-running with the same pair is effectively idempotent.

createOrUpdateUser.name: createOrUpdateUser
createOrUpdateUser.description: Create a new user profile or update an existing user profile with custom properties

id.description: The unique identifier of the user

email.description: The email address of the user

data.description: Custom user properties (e.g., first_name, last_name, timezone). Reserved properties: language, timezone, userAgent

channels.description: Device tokens for push notifications and other communication channels

address.description: The address for the channel (e.g., UNIQUE_DEVICE_TOKEN)

platform.description: The platform for push notifications (e.g., iOS, Android)

aiMetadata.description: Upserts a Vero user profile keyed on the supplied user ID, setting the email and any custom properties and communication channels (e.g. push device tokens). Use to register a new contact or to enrich/refresh an existing one. ID and email are required; because it is keyed on the stable ID, repeating the same call is idempotent.

deleteUser.name: deleteUser
deleteUser.description: Delete a user and all their properties and activities permanently. This action is irreversible.

id.description: The unique identifier of the user to delete

aiMetadata.description: Permanently deletes a Vero user, identified by user ID, along with all of their properties and activity history. This is irreversible. Re-running on an already-deleted ID has no further effect, so it is effectively idempotent on the same target.

resubscribeUser.name: resubscribeUser
resubscribeUser.description: Globally resubscribe a user to all communications

id.description: The unique identifier of the user

aiMetadata.description: Globally resubscribes a Vero user, identified by user ID, restoring their consent to receive all communications. Use to reverse a prior unsubscribe. Repeating the call leaves the user subscribed, so it is idempotent.

trackEvent.name: trackEvent
trackEvent.description: Track a custom event for a user

userId.description: Unique database identifier for the user

eventName.description: Name of the event being tracked

extras.description: Additional metadata for the event (e.g., source, createdAt)

aiMetadata.description: Records a custom analytics event in Vero for a user (identified by user ID and email), with an event name and optional event data and metadata. Use to log a user action that can drive campaigns or segmentation. Each call appends a new event occurrence, so it is not idempotent.

unsubscribe.name: unsubscribe
unsubscribe.description: Globally unsubscribe a user from all communications

id.description: The unique identifier of the user

aiMetadata.description: Globally unsubscribes a Vero user, identified by user ID, withdrawing their consent so they no longer receive any communications. Use to honor an opt-out. Repeating the call leaves the user unsubscribed, so it is idempotent.

updateUsersTags.name: updateUsersTags
updateUsersTags.description: Add or remove tags from a user profile

id.description: The unique identifier of the user

add.description: An array of tags to add to the user

remove.description: An array of tags to remove from the user

aiMetadata.description: Adds and/or removes tags on a Vero user profile identified by user ID, supplying lists of tags to add, remove, or both. Use to segment or label a user. Applying the same add/remove sets converges to the same tag state, so it is idempotent.

pt.Vero is an event-based messaging platfor: Vero é uma plataforma de mensagens baseadas em eventos. Aumente as conversões e a satisfação do cliente enviando e-mails mais direcionados.
pt.Change a user's identifier by merging tw: Alterar o identificador de um usuário mesclando duas identidades de usuário em uma
pt.Create a new user profile or update an e: Crie um novo perfil de usuário ou atualize um perfil de usuário existente com propriedades personalizadas
pt.Delete a user and all their properties a: Excluir um usuário e todas suas propriedades e atividades permanentemente. Esta ação é irreversível.
pt.Globally resubscribe a user to all commu: Recadastrar um usuário globalmente para todas as comunicações
pt.Track a custom event for a user: Rastrear um evento personalizado para um usuário
pt.Globally unsubscribe a user from all com: Desinscrever um usuário globalmente em todas as comunicações
pt.Add or remove tags from a user profile: Adicionar ou remover etiquetas de um perfil de usuário
pt.The old unique identifier of the user: O identificador exclusivo antigo do usuário
pt.The new unique identifier of the user: O novo identificador exclusivo do usuário
pt.The email address of the user: O endereço de email do usuário
pt.Custom user properties (e.g., first_name: Propriedades do usuário personalizadas (por exemplo, primeiro_name, last_name, timezone). Propriedades reservadas: idioma, fuso horário, userAgent
pt.Device tokens for push notifications and: Tokens de dispositivos para notificações push e outros canais de comunicação
pt.The unique identifier of the user to del: O identificador exclusivo do usuário a ser excluído
pt.Unique database identifier for the user: Identificador exclusivo do banco de dados para o usuário
pt.Name of the event being tracked: Nome do evento a ser rastreado
pt.Event-specific data and properties: Propriedades e dados e propriedades específicos do evento
pt.Additional metadata for the event (e.g.,: Metadados adicionais para o evento (por exemplo, fonte, criado)
pt.An array of tags to add to the user: Uma matriz de tags para adicionar ao usuário
pt.An array of tags to remove from the user: Um array de tags para remover do usuário
pt.Triggered when an email bounces: Acionada quando um e-mail foi devolvido
pt.Triggered when an email is clicked: Acionada quando um e-mail é clicado
pt.Triggered when an email is marked as com: Acionada quando um e-mail é marcado como reclamado
pt.Triggered when an email is opened: Acionada quando um e-mail é aberto
pt.Triggered when a new user is created: Acionada quando um novo usuário é criado
